title: project-autopilot config
description: The v4 `.autopilot/config.json` layout: settings grouped by what you decide, with units in the names.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema file.

schema_version.description: On-disk config format version; always 4.0 for this layout.

project.description: Project identity and which planning framework drives it.

repo.description: Repository root the mission runs in.

planning_framework.description: Which planning framework to drive (auto, standalone, speckit or gsd).

roles.description: The agent CLI, model and session settings for each role.

cli.description: Agent CLI adapter for this role (claude, opencode, codex, ...).

model.description: Model id for this role; empty means the adapter default.

reasoning.description: Reasoning effort for this role; empty means the adapter default.

variant.description: Adapter-specific model variant; empty means none.

resume_session.description: Resume the previous session for this role instead of starting fresh. Defaults to false for the implementer: a capped implementer continues in a fresh session with the hand-off note (the wrap-up turn still resumes); every other role defaults to true.

fallbacks.description: Ordered fallback role entries tried when the primary adapter/model fails.

escalation_model.description: Stronger model used for the next fix round after retries.escalate_after_not_fixed not-fixed reports; null or absent turns escalation off.

cli.description: Agent CLI adapter for the escalation model; empty means the role's adapter.

model.description: Model id for the escalation model; empty means the role's model.

reasoning.description: Reasoning effort for the escalation model; empty means the role's effort.

variant.description: Adapter-specific model variant for the escalation model; empty means none.

plan_reviewer.description: Role settings for the plan reviewer.

auto_fallback.description: Automatically fall back to a free model when the primary is unavailable.

max_turns.description: Maximum turns allowed on a free-model fallback before giving up.

caps.description: Per-role turn, token and session caps plus the mission token backstop.

task_size_target_turns.description: Target turns per task used when splitting oversized work.

max_turns.description: Maximum model turns for this role in one session; at the limit the role stops and hands off, and extra_sessions decides whether it may continue.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens for this role in one session; at the limit the role stops and hands off, and extra_sessions decides whether it may continue.

extra_sessions.description: Extra sessions this role may start after hitting its turn or token cap; at the limit no further session is started and the mission stops or reports the cap.

wrap_up_at_tokens.description: Token count at which this role is told to wrap up and hand off before reaching max_tokens; at the limit the role writes its hand-off and stops.

mission_token_backstop.description: Raw-token backstop for a whole mission before it is stopped.

retries.description: Retry and revision budgets for each stage.

plan_revisions.description: Maximum plan revision rounds before plan review gives up.

implementation.description: Failure budget for the implementation phase.

verification.description: Failure budget for the verification phase.

final_review_fix_rounds.description: Maximum final-review fix rounds before stopping.

cli_errors.description: Adapter retry budget for transient CLI errors.

no_progress_sessions.description: Consecutive no-progress generations before a mission is stopped.

extra_sessions_per_task.description: Continuation sessions allowed per task (mirrors caps.implementer.extra_sessions).

escalate_after_not_fixed.description: Consecutive reviews that must report the same finding not fixed before the escalation model is used (1 = escalate on the first not-fixed report).

time_limits.description: Wall-clock limits and waits, with the unit in each name.

role_timeout_minutes.description: Per-role session timeout overrides, in minutes.

default.description: Default wall-clock limit per role session, in minutes.

verifier.description: Wall-clock limit for the verifier role session, in minutes.

call_backstop_minutes.description: Hard wall-clock backstop for ONE role call, in minutes (not a mission limit): a call that runs past it is stopped. The old name mission_timeout_minutes is still read and migrated.

role_timeout_floor_minutes.description: Minimum per-role timeout floor in minutes; null disables the floor.

silent_run_minutes.description: Minutes of silence before an active run is treated as hung.

no_first_output_minutes.description: Minutes allowed before a session must produce its first output.

read_only_max_silence_minutes.description: Maximum silence for read-only roles, in minutes.

workflow.description: Which review and approval stages run, and how work is committed.

plan_review.description: Run a plan review stage before implementation.

plan_review_rounds_converge.description: Iterate plan review rounds until the plan converges.

code_review_per_phase.description: Run code review after each implementation phase.

final_review.description: Run a final review at the end of the mission.

analysis_after_tasks.description: Run an analysis pass after all tasks complete.

approve_spec_myself.description: Auto-approve the spec without asking the operator.

approve_plan_myself.description: Auto-approve the plan without asking the operator.

use_worktrees.description: Use git worktrees to isolate parallel work.

commit_by_human.description: Only a human may commit; roles never run git commit.

tests.description: Gate commands, reviewer requirement and verification policy.

gate_commands.description: Commands run as the phase/mission gate.

gate_network.description: Allow the gate commands to use the network (false keeps them network-isolated).

gate_env_allowlist.description: Environment variables allowed through to gate commands.

require_reviewer.description: Require a reviewer role to sign off before completion.

browser.description: Browser capability mode used for verification (native, playwright or both).

require_browser.description: When browser verification is required (always, when-task-requires or never).

verify_denylist.description: Commands or paths never allowed in verification.

safety.description: What roles may do and which safety checks are enforced.

allow_git_commit.description: Permit roles to run git commit.

allow_git_push.description: Permit roles to run git push.

allow_destructive_operations.description: Permit destructive filesystem or git operations.

stop_on_sandbox_violation.description: Stop the mission when a sandbox/relay violation is detected.

block_git_in_roles.description: Block git commit/push inside role sessions.

check_read_only_roles.description: Verify read-only roles by comparing snapshots.

record_touched_files.description: Capture the files each role touches.

keep_role_sessions.description: Persist role sessions so they can be resumed.

runtime.description: Containment mode and, for WSL2, the distribution to use.

mode.description: Runtime containment mode (auto, linux-strong, wsl2-strong or windows-compatibility).

wsl_distro.description: WSL2 distribution to use for wsl2-strong mode; null means auto-detect.

frameworks.description: Per-framework planning settings for SpecKit and GSD.

workflow_file.description: Path to the SpecKit workflow definition.

task_files.description: Glob patterns that identify SpecKit task files.

gsd.description: GSD phase, artifact and parallelism settings.

phase_root.description: Root directory holding GSD phase folders.

use_gsd_tools_when_available.description: Use GSD helper tools when they are available.

review_after_each_stage.description: Review after every GSD planning stage.

read_only_reviewer.description: Use a read-only reviewer for GSD planning review.

min_plans_for_parallel.description: Minimum plans before parallel GSD execution starts.

advanced.description: Paths, hand-off limits and capability defaults.

state_file.description: Path to the mission state file.

handoff_max_chars.description: Maximum characters in a role hand-off document.

handoff_note_max_chars.description: Maximum characters in a hand-off note.

handoff_wrapup_tokens.description: Token count at which a role is told to wrap up its hand-off.

fallback_retry_primary_minutes.description: Minutes to wait before retrying the primary model after a fallback took over.

checkpoint_after_task.description: Write a checkpoint after each task.

checkpoint_after_phase.description: Write a checkpoint after each phase.

project_defaults.description: Capabilities assumed present for this project.

legacy_text_inference.description: Infer capabilities from task text (legacy behaviour).
